scope: Published expectations in TEA chapters 110–113, subchapters A–D; excludes external curricula and other TEKS subjects.
note: Compact verified observations, not full provider traces. Full hashed raw artifacts retained locally. No raw question text, credentials or private correspondence.

protocol.amendment: Full published four-subject extraction; course grades are null in model input when not explicitly fixed; B branch routing batches when too large. Same standard-selection prompt, seeds, top-k and RRF settings. Prior evidence preserved.
protocol.strategyOrder: Rotate A/B/C by item and repeat; shuffle options and A partitions by repeat seed

strategies.A: All records; max 210 options / 28000 UTF-8 request bytes per batch; top 3 per batch; joint final Choice
strategies.B: Top 2 subjects, top 2 grade/course branches per subject, top 3 per leaf batch; joint final Choice
strategies.C: No subject filter; exact cosine + BM25 (k1=1.2,b=.75); top40 each; RRF k=60; top30 -> joint final Choice

protocol.questionInput: Original extracted text only; labels never enter requests
protocol.caveats: Exploratory development pilot, not a fresh holdout. Public questions may be in training data. Repeats are not independent questions. Final confidence is conditional on finalists. No screenshot extraction or lesson generation.

protocol.note: Known grade is a separately labeled oracle-metadata ablation, not evidence of grade inference. No codes, question IDs or answer-key text enter provider requests. Same finalists, no pruning. Reused development questions, not a fresh holdout.
